brief: A display stand with the large platform on a spike where three bases meet.

requirements.evidence: Three triangular full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full) form the footprint, capped with solid end caps (capOpenFaces) and locked with joint bolts (lockJoints); check_build ok, meshClash clear.
setSpikeAccessory with accessory platform-lrg applied to the spike (5 parts in budget after fitting); confirmed in catalog as 'Platform, large' (51.9 x 60 x 3 mm).

Mount spike added via offer s14 (addSpike, variant mount) as spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0; the mount type is what traps the platform plate per the catalog use note, and the platform-lrg was then set on that spike accessory slot.

requirements.requirement: Spike positioned where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: Spike junction is exactly the three base cells [{0,0},{0,1},{1,0}] at level 0 — the corner shared by all three full bases, as offered by s14 at that junction.

finish.summary: Built a display stand from three full bases in a triangular cluster (0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1 at level 0). A mount spike rises at the junction where all three bases meet, and the large platform (platform-lrg, 51.9 x 60 mm) is fitted on it as the spike accessory. House rules applied: all open faces closed with solid caps and joints locked with bolts. check_build reports ok with meshClash clear. No props were added: the spike/platform exposes no surface token for a prop to rest on, so the stand is left empty for whatever you choose to display.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
